info.name: Kontrol S8 Mixxx Windows v1.0 HID
info.author: Kontrol S8 mapping contributors
info.description: Kontrol S8 Windows HID input and LED mapping for the documented Mixxx revision.

option.label: Maximize the Mixxx library while the S8 browser is open
option.description: Off keeps the decks visible; the S8 displays show the browser either way.

option.label: Debug logging (every input event and LED report)
option.description: Off for performance: logging each event adds latency to fast fader moves.

option.label: Sample pads play only while held
option.description: Release stops the sample and returns to its start. Off: a press plays the whole sample, Shift+pad stops it.

option.label: Linear channel faders (gain follows the fader, like the stem faders)
option.description: Off uses Mixxx's audio taper: -20..0 dB over the travel, half travel = -12 dB.
